description: The chart illustrates the comprehensive evaluation results on academic and practical benchmarks, comparing the performance of different models across various datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, while the vertical axis represents the score percentage, ranging from 0 to 80 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a dataset or metric and containing four bars corresponding to different models: LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (red). The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and the categories are listed in a fixed order. The scores for the models are generally high for GSM-8K, around 75-80%, and vary across the other categories, with some models performing similarly, such as the three "Ours" models, which often have identical or very close scores, while LLaMA-3-8B-it tends to have lower scores, particularly for TruthfulQA, LC AlpacaEval-2, and Chat-Arena-Hard, with values around 45%, 12%, and 18%, respectively.
